smells.finding: scripts/verify_episode_captured.py:201 -- `Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent / "episodes"` is a four-link navigation chain whose meaning depends entirely on where the file sits on disk, and Fowler's objection to message chains (the caller is coupled to a traversal it does not own) is exactly the failure mode this one has: on a copy bundled into a skill and installed under ~/.claude/skills/<role>/, the chain silently resolves to the skill install directory instead of the repo, so the gate would report green against a store outside the project. This is an OBSERVATION, not a blocker, on three grounds: it is named in a comment at the code site (lines 196-200), the resolved root is printed on every outcome so a wrong root is visible in the gate log rather than silent, and the implementer floated it as an open decision for g3 to close by wiring --store-root explicitly into the spine commands. The identical chain at scripts/apply_episode_delta.py:523 is the precedent it matches, and that one now carries the same hazard comment. Recommended close at g3: pass --store-root explicitly from both spine templates, which is already what verify_retirement.py's replacement-absent leg is waiting on.

override.repo_standard: The g2 handoff's scope-discipline constraint, quoting Tommy's standing epic-418 ruling: 'A corner case deliberately not chased must carry a comment AT THE CODE SITE naming it and be reported up.' Plus docs/agents/CREW_CONTEXT.md 'Verification Discipline', which makes the reason a guard exists part of the guard's contract.
override.reason: Comment and docstring prose is a large fraction of the 245-line module: a 38-line module docstring, multi-paragraph docstrings on every function, and three long inline blocks. Under a naive Fowler read that is deodorant. It is not, for two reasons. First, the ruling above makes exactly this density mandatory -- three of the four declined corner cases ARE these comment blocks, and I verified each is at its stated file:line (125-130, 151-161, 196-201) rather than a paraphrase pointing elsewhere. Second, what the comments carry is not a restatement of the code but the DESIGN INTENT the code cannot express: why scan_episode() stops at '## Agent-supplied', why the writer is deliberately not imported, why retired/ is not searched, why a relative pathspec had to be resolved. Deodorant hides unclear code; this prose records a constraint that would otherwise be one innocent refactor from being violated -- and my mutation testing confirmed the code, not the prose, is what enforces it. The standard wins.
